sequential_dependency.intermediate: The docked grid and its four-connected multicolor foreground groups.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Match eight-connected pieces under all rotations/reflections and dock matches at the top, unique shapes at the bottom.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the uniquely largest docked foreground group and recolor exactly its cells cyan.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Several originally separate smaller pieces join only after docking; original size, shape-class totals and color totals do not determine the largest final connected group.

parametric_work.summary: Shape matching and docking, then largest connected docked group. Supports 2..6 demonstrations and independent 1..4 privately shuffled query prefixes; minimum two-demo lesson rejects finite executable rivals.

target.self_review: Author self-review; no independent subagent reviewer available.
